note: Lean carries the vacuum majorant q_k as `Vac.treasury`, the radius as the abstract weight w with hypothesis w*moneys <= fly, and arbitrary weights i in place of a product of marks over the tiling; the constant 6 is the same.

lemma occurs {B:Census V} (hQ:k<N)(hK:C.ref d≤k)(hw:∀ i,0<w i)(hr:∀ i,w i*moneys C d k N p (s i)≤ fly C.path.levels d k)
    (hp:Migrating C.path k p N o)(hv:Occupancy (o k) (r k))(hx: Drake B (C.path.levels.budget k).B (o k))(i:B.Mode): ‖C.omega N p (fun V=> ∏ j∈ i.val,U j V)‖* Poly.toll w i ≤ Real.exp (Fintype.card (Site (C.side k p))* Vac.treasury C.path.levels k+ Fintype.card V*(6:ℝ)):=by

proof_context.conclusion: `||omega(prod U j)|| * toll w i <= exp(|Site k| * treasury k + |V| * 6)`, the bound with 3+1+2 = 6 per mark.

lemma tent (hm: Stock.Tabs.opens C.path.levels 1 m k)(hd:C.ref d ≤ m) (hN:k<N)(he:(F).coeffSize v≤a):
    (Cells.center C.S p (hm.1.trans hN.le) 0).rootTest (C.beta N p) (C.O N p v 0) ≤ Real.exp (expense C a m k d):=by

proof_context.conclusion: The cell root of the replicated product is at most `exp (expense C a m k d)`, with `expense = (a_m/a_k)^4 treasury + 6 - log plumR`.
